description: This file defines a Java interface named ConfigurationConsumer, which specifies methods for handling configuration files, including starting and ending file processing and handling structural data.

classes.name: ConfigurationConsumer
classes.description: An interface defining callback methods for processing configuration files, including start, end, and handle struct events.

methods.name: startFile
methods.description: Method invoked at the beginning of processing a configuration file.

methods.name: endFile
methods.description: Method invoked at the end of processing a configuration file.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Method invoked to handle the end of a configuration structure, accepting a ConfigStructure object.
